Brookswood, September 2026. Detached houses: 98 listed at month end and 7 sold in September, a sales ratio of 7% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 2 listed at month end and 0 sold in September, a sales ratio of —.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 32 sold over 4 months against an average of 86.0 listed, about 10.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 11 sold. Condos and townhomes: 0 sold over 4 months against an average of 0.5 listed.

faq.a: The Brookswood-Fernridge Community Plan covers Brookswood-Fernridge, with neighbourhood plans for Booth, Fernridge and Rinn.

faq.q: How did Brookswood sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached: 98 listings, 7 sold, 7% sales ratio — the lowest published detached ratio in the Langley sub-area set that month. Condos & Townhomes: 2 listings, 0 sold. No Brookswood-only median is published; the combined Langley medians (detached $1,345,000; attached $611,000) blend in the City of Langley and the other Township sub-areas and are not Brookswood figures (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: How is school catchment checked in Brookswood?
faq.a: School District 35's School Locator returns the catchment school for a street address; the sample address 20902 37A Avenue was run in the locator and returned no result, so no catchment is confirmed for it. Schools physically in the area include Brookswood Secondary at 20902 37A Avenue, Alice Brown Elementary at 20011 44 Avenue and Noel Booth Elementary at 20202 35 Avenue (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).
TransLink routes 531, 561 and 563 serve 200 Street at 37A Avenue, with 561 named Brookswood and 563 named Fernridge on the TransLink stop page, connecting to Langley Centre.
